_doc: ROADMAP 7.1n4: program's CHIP data hunks as C++ objects. S_27 (BSS, 45,744 bytes) is the cel read buffer / scratch block; S_30 (DATA) is the display cell block: shown/draw screen cells (patched by program.display.json screen-a/b to rt_screen_b / rt_screen_work), the default palette, the null sprite, the ORIGINAL copper-list template (LAB_0570/0571, read only by the dead body of the display init since ACE owns the display: kept byte-identical), the hex digit string and the keyboard table. Chip placement: tools/gen_data.py puts the objects in .chipdata.MEMF_CHIP / .chipbss.MEMF_CHIP (elf2hunk -> MEMF_CHIP hunks; tests/test_gen_data.py parses the exe). The twins are in mog.data_chip.json.
